en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 12.Muḥammad ibn Sinān said, “A man narrated to me from Abū Khālid al-Ṣayqal, from Abū Jaʿfar (a) who said, ‘

Verily the inhabitants of Paradise will have table spreads placed for them upon which will be all that they desire of foods that are incomparable in terms of their deliciousness and goodness, then [once they have partaken of it,] they will be moved from that to another.’”
